text: Not always. There's a lot of useful information online, but anybody can publish anything, so you have to be careful. Fake news spreads very quickly on social media, for example. In my experience, it's wise to check several sources and prefer official websites or well-known organisations. I also think schools should teach students how to evaluate what they read online, because this skill is just as important as reading itself.

tips.en: Not always is a precise, careful answer.
tips.kk: Not always — дәл әрі сақ жауап.
tips.ru: Not always — точный и осторожный ответ.

tips.en: In my experience backs the advice with experience.
tips.kk: In my experience кеңесті жеке тәжірибемен қуаттайды.
tips.ru: In my experience подкрепляет совет личным опытом.
tips.example: In my experience, it's wise to check several sources

text: I think the biggest change is convenience. Nowadays you can order almost anything from your sofa and receive it in a few days, and you can easily compare prices. On the other hand, many small shops have lost customers because they can't compete with big online platforms. Personally, I buy books and electronics online, but I still prefer to try on clothes in a shop, because sizes can be different.

tips.en: The biggest change is names the main effect.
tips.kk: The biggest change is басты әсерді бірден атайды.
tips.ru: The biggest change is сразу называет главный эффект.
tips.example: I think the biggest change is convenience

tips.en: Personally moves to your own experience.
tips.example: Personally, I buy books and electronics online, but I still prefer to try on clothes in a shop

text: Yes, definitely. Children can spend hours on games or videos, and this may affect their sleep, their studies and even their eyesight. Parents should set clear rules, for example no phones during dinner or after a certain time in the evening. However, I think it's better to explain the reasons instead of just forbidding things, because otherwise children may simply find ways to avoid the rules.

tips.en: Instead of contrasts two ways of acting.
tips.kk: Instead of екі әрекет тәсілін салыстырады.
tips.ru: Instead of противопоставляет два способа действия.
tips.example: it's better to explain the reasons instead of just forbidding things

text: I think it'll become more personalised and more integrated into daily life. For instance, doctors might use online systems to monitor patients remotely, and students in small villages could attend lessons given by the best teachers in the country. The main risk is privacy, because companies collect a lot of personal data. So governments will need to create stricter rules to protect users.

tips.en: For instance introduces a real-life example.
tips.kk: For instance нақты өмірден мысал енгізеді.
tips.ru: For instance вводит пример из реальной жизни.
tips.example: For instance, doctors might use online systems to monitor patients remotely

tips.en: The main risk is focuses on the key problem.
tips.kk: The main risk is басты мәселеге бағыттайды.
tips.ru: The main risk is фокусирует на главной проблеме.
